rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (15 tracks) per https://usstore.edsheeran.com/products/play-deluxe-cd, https://store.warnermusic.com.au/products/play-deluxe-cd-signed-polaroid. 15 tracks = 13 standard Play tracks + 2 deluxe bonus tracks (Problems, War Game), per Ed Sheeran's official US store and Warner Music Australasia. Deluxe CD release date: 12 September 2025. Note: a later 'expanded deluxe' (streaming/book LP, 28 Nov 2025) adds 13 more tracks (Regrets, Freedom, Skeletons, Technicolor, Satellite, Lights Out, Fade Out, Crashing, Rapture, Spiral, I Don't Wanna Go To Bed, Sapphire feat. Arijit Singh, etc.) — that is a separate later expanded edition, NOT this Deluxe CD release.
